topIssues.title: op-reth: Remove reth submodule and update CI to use op-reth
topIssues.author: theochap
topIssues.body:
## Summary

Now that op-reth has been added to the monorepo under `op-reth/`, we should remove the `reth` submodule and update all CI workflows to build and test against the `op-reth/` directory instead.

## Tasks

- [ ] Remove the `reth` git submodule
- [ ] Update CI workflows that reference the `reth` submodule to use `op-reth/` instead
- [ ] Update any scripts or documentation that reference the submodule
- [ ] Verify all op-reth builds and tests pass in CI

## Context

The `reth` submodule was used to include op-reth in the monorepo. With the migration of op-reth source code directly into `op-reth/`, the submodule is no longer needed and should be removed to avoid confusion and maintain a single source of truth.

Related: #18917

topIssues.title: op-reth: port documentation from reth to op-reth
topIssues.author: theochap
topIssues.body:
## Description

The op-reth documentation currently lives in the upstream [reth](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth) repository. Now that op-reth is part of the optimism monorepo, the OP Stack-specific documentation should be ported over and maintained here.

## Scope

- Port all OP Stack documentation pages from reth (OP Stack running guide, sync FAQ, full op-reth CLI reference).
- Set up a Vocs-based documentation site under `op-reth/docs/vocs/`.
- Add justfile recipes for building and previewing the docs.
- Add a CircleCI job to build the documentation on CI.
- Add `bun` to `mise.toml` for the docs build toolchain.

topIssues.title: Fix devfeatures cyclic dependency
topIssues.author: 0xniha
topIssues.body:
**Description**

Development feature flags are hardcoded as hex values in multiple places throughout `op-deployer/pkg/deployer/pipeline/`.

A source of truth exists in `op-deployer/pkg/deployer/devfeatures.go` with named constants (`L2CMDevFlag`, `OPCMV2DevFlag`, etc.) and the `IsDevFeatureEnabled()` function. However, the `pipeline` package cannot import it due to an import cycle, resulting in duplicated code including the `isDevFeatureEnabled` function in `opchain.go`.

**Solution**

Move `op-deployer/pkg/deployer/devfeatures.go` to a utils package (e.g., `op-deployer/pkg/deployer/devfeatures`) that can be imported by both `deployer` and `pipeline` packages.

topPRs.author: theochap
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Ports OP Stack documentation from the upstream `reth` repository into `op-reth/docs/vocs/`, including the OP Stack running guide, sync FAQ, and full CLI reference (64 pages).

```
- Can you make sure that the ported documentation compiles and work in the op-reth destination
- Can you add a circle CI job in @.circleci/continue/op-reth.yml that builds and deploys the documentation. A bit similar to what kona has (kona-docs-build in @.circleci/continue/kona.yml). Import the commands to build the docs from an op-reth justfile recipe.
```

```

```

topPRs.title: chore(ci): remove YAML anchors from CircleCI configs
topPRs.author: theochap
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Inlines all YAML anchors, aliases, and merge keys in CircleCI continuation configs
- Fixes compatibility with the `circleci/path-filtering@3.0.0` orb's config merge step, which uses `yq eval-all 'explode(.) | . as $item ireduce ({}; . * $item)'` and can fail non-deterministically with anchors (see [path-filtering-orb#100](https://github.com/CircleCI-Public/path-filtering-orb/issues/100))
- Resolves `bad file '.circleci/continue/rust-ci.yml': yaml: line 8: mapping values are not allowed in this context` errors seen in GitHub merge queue

### Files changed
- `.circleci/continue/rust-ci.yml` — inlined `&cache-params`, 18 cache-args anchor pairs, and `&rust-ci-context` (~25 usages)
- `.circleci/continue/rust-e2e.yml` — inlined `&kona-rust-build-release`, `&rust-e2e-job-base`, removed anchor-only markers
- `.circleci/continue/main.yml` — inlined `&features_matrix`, `&rust-build-op-rbuilder`, `&rust-build-rollup-boost`, removed anchor-only markers

## Test plan
- [x] All three files validate as correct YAML with both yq v4.48.1 and v4.34.1
- [x] Full three-file merge pipeline (`yq eval-all 'explode(.) | . as $item ireduce ({}; . * $item)'`) succeeds
- [x] No remaining YAML anchors, aliases, or merge keys
- [ ] CI passes on this PR
